mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ia.FUND_CD , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , ia.MG_CD , F_FUND_COLOR(#{corpGr}, ia.FUND_CD, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS fund_color , ia.ENC_ACCT_NO , TO_DECRYPTS(ia.ENC_ACCT_NO) AS acct_no , TO_CHAR(ia.FST_SEOLJ_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fst_seolj_ymd , TO_CHAR(t2.BF_GYUL_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bf_gyul_ymd , TO_CHAR(t2.HAEJI_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS haeji_ymd FROM SZM0IA ia JOIN SZM0GI t2 ON t2.CORP_GR = ia.CORP_GR AND t2.FUND_CD = ia.FUND_CD WHERE ia.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND ia.MG_CD LIKE #{mgCd} AND COALESCE(ia.HAEJI_YMD, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') + 1) > TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN (t2.BF_GYUL_YMD + 1) AND t2.AF_GYUL_YMD ORDER BY ia.MG_CD ASC , ia.FUND_CD ASC
